//: Composite indexes for the queries that filter on more than one field.
Firestore serves single-field filters from automatic indexes, which is why
most of this app needs none — the API deliberately does one filter in the
query and refines the rest in process over a bounded result set. These are
the three places where that would have meant reading a whole collection.
Deploy with:  gcloud firestore indexes create --file=firestore.indexes.json
or let scripts/setup.sh do it, which is idempotent.

indexes.//: documents.find_by_hash: the upload cache. Runs on every upload and every scheduled re-read, so it is the hottest compound query in the system.
sources.find_by_url: dedupes a watched address so one URL cannot be registered twice and checked twice.
alerts and the timeline: status-change events, newest first.
